page.overview:
Who is Carson?

Carson is a Flip-Flopian that is red in color and has a large mustache.

Carson is the owner of the bar, The Overthere, that resides in Flopside. Carson is well known for being very knowledgeable and, for 10 coins, will tell any of his stories. Carson has fifteen stories in total.
